alias_selection.policy: verified source-native names plus first 10 ordered PubChem synonyms per mapped CID, IUPAC fallback, reviewed aflatoxin variants; generic terms excluded; abbreviations case-sensitive

limitations: Coverage means at least one verified name per heldout connectivity, not exhaustive synonyms.
Name transfer follows frozen source and TDC gold identity lineage; no label votes are inferred from aliases.

reviewed_card_exclusions.reason: Source dimethylated acetaminophen analog includes acetaminophen oxygen/amide chemistry, but assigned analog is oxygen-free 2,6-dimethylaniline; no parent/metabolite relationship supports attribution. Exact supplied card held, not the whole parent.
